name: This Is Fine
meaning: A cartoon dog sits calmly at a table sipping coffee while the room is on fire. For denial: pretending everything is okay while things fall apart.
when_to_use: left = the situation that is on fire (top of the left panel). right = leave empty; the speech bubble already says the punchline.
baked_in_text: The speech bubble already says "THIS IS FINE." Only caption the left box (the situation). Do not restate the punchline.
